author: Nawder Loswin
description: Four-quadrant view of the Open Loop suite mapped by primary ring and regime.

Q1.label: Governance · Trust
Q1.description: Modules whose primary ring is Trust and whose regime is governance or classification. These modules gate and verify before anything moves.

Q2.label: Governance · Meaning
Q2.description: Modules whose regime is registry/governance but that carry Meaning-ring responsibilities — maintaining the permanent record of operations.

Q3.label: Execution · Trust
Q3.description: Modules whose primary ring bridges Trust and execution substrate. Execution only proceeds after Trust clearance from OpenIAM.

Q4.label: Execution · Motion
Q4.description: Modules whose primary concern is active operation in time and space — semantic generation, geospatial grounding.

execution_order.description: Canonical operator application sequence across the suite for a full cross-domain operation.

steps.action: Verify principal identity and issue access clearance
